newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico seizes huge cocaine shipment.
newsitem.headline: Mexico seizes huge cocaine shipment.

text.p: The Mexican Coast Guard seized 3.3 tonnes of cocaine aboard a fishing boat and arrested eight people, the government news agency Notimex reported on Thursday.

The drugs, of unknown origin, were discovered on Wednesday aboard the Mexican-flagged fishing boat off the west coast state of Colima, Notimex said, citing Navy officials in the port city of Manzanillo.
It was one of the largest drug busts in recent months, Notimex added.
